Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can offer a voucher conversion and a time‑boxed top‑up; details below.

Options we recommend (fastest to close):
• 2‑week Top‑up (preferred): Convert the remaining trial days into a voucher that covers a 14‑day extension on the same Dedicated evaluation profile. Price = prorated list for 14 days at current pilot rate; we can apply a 10% commercial credit if payment is made within 7 days.
• Prepay + Commitment Ladder: Prepay for a 30‑day block at a 15% discount, with an optional conversion clause that trades unused days for a credit applied to a first committed month if you convert to Dedicated within 45 days.
• Short grace voucher + engineering hours: Keep the trial live for 2 weeks and add a 10‑hour engineering package (discounted) to help with KV‑cache tuning and perf validation.

Commercial notes: a 20% one‑time off invoice discount is above our standard flexibility for a pilot; I'd like Ben and Kimberly to confirm whether we can stretch to that under the current playbook or if we should structure a staged discount tied to a convert‑to‑commit milestone.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm financial approval for a 15% prepaid discount or escalate the 20% ask.
2) Kimberly to draft a brief amendment to the SOW (voucher wording + conversion clause).
3) If you approve option 1, we'll send a one‑page amendment and invoice for the 2‑week top‑up today.

I'll hold any price commitments until we hear back from Ben/Kimberly but want to keep this quick.

Thanks — LH
